title: ⚡ Bolt: Optimize session archiving cleanup
body:
💡 What: Replaced O(N^2) array `.find()` in chunked loops with a pre-built O(N) `Map` lookup and added missing try...catch block to sequential operations on same entity.
🎯 Why: To fix performance degradation scaling with total sessions when archiving medium-priority sessions, which causes redundant array scans, and ensure we do not delete original file if archiving fails.
📊 Impact: Changes O(N^2) array lookup overhead inside concurrent Promise mapping into O(N) linear time for building Map and O(1) for getting session, making cleanup performant for large session counts.
🔬 Measurement: Run `bun test ./tests/unit/core/session/manager-archive.test.ts` and `bun run test:full` to verify safety.

---
